API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APISegment Group ManagementGets the Segment Group details for the specified ID.
Gets the Segment Group details for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/segmentGroup/:segmentGroupId

Gets the Segment Group details for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

segmentGroupId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Segment Group.

QUERY PARAMETERS
skipDetailedAppInfo
boolean

Indicates whether to include complete application details or not.

Default value: false
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415

503

OK
